notes.title: Choose Your Guardian & Skip Cutscenes
notes.notes:
Guardian System: At the start of the game, you can now choose a Guardian to accompany you. If you don’t pick one, a more neutral Guardian will appear occasionally—sometimes guiding you, sometimes misleading you… or both.
Skip Cutscenes & Dialogue: You can now skip certain cutscenes and dialogue scenes. However, if you want to fully experience the story,recommend keeping them on.

notes.title: Guess Who's Back?
notes.notes:
Hope y'all have a great day! I am glad to say that the game is back, with some changes that you will uncover through your HeavenBrook run.

To those who patiently waited and to those who chose the way of soft violence at critics and left early—well, I chose a way more aggressive. And soon enough, you will be awarded with some extra gameplay, let's say.

Also, thank you for all these downloads! Hope you enjoy it now.
